title: AML Tool Definition
description: Compiled JSON payload for an AML tool definition (.tool.md). Validates that the compiled output conforms to the AML v1.2 specification.

spec_version.title: Spec Version
spec_version.description: AML format version. Must equal a platform-approved version string.

tool_id.title: Tool ID
tool_id.description: Stable, immutable identifier for this tool. Lowercase kebab-case. Immutable once any agent references it in a published definition.

version.title: Version
version.description: Semantic version of this tool definition. Major bump required for breaking changes to the parameter schema.

status.title: Status
status.description: Lifecycle state. draft=not usable in production; active=usable; deprecated=usable but lint warning on referencing agents; disabled=hard compile error on reference.

meta.title: Metadata
meta.description: Descriptive metadata for this tool. Written from the model's perspective.

name.title: Name
name.description: Human-readable display name for this tool.

description.title: Description
description.description: Two to five sentences describing what this tool does from the model's perspective. Used by the model at runtime to decide when to call this tool.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: Team responsible for maintaining this tool.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Searchable labels for discovery and filtering.

last_updated.title: Last Updated
last_updated.description: ISO 8601 date of the last update to this tool definition.

type.title: Type
type.description: Behavioral semantics of the tool. retrieval=read-only lookup, no side effects; action=causes an external side effect; function=in-process computation, no external call; human=routes to a human reviewer. Separate from invocation protocol (declared in transport).

interface.title: Interface
interface.description: Input and output contract for this tool.

input.title: Input
input.description: JSON Schema describing the tool's input parameters. Used by the compiler and model at runtime to construct correct tool calls.

output.title: Output
output.description: JSON Schema describing the structure of a successful tool response. Required so the model can interpret results without ambiguity.

transport.title: Transport
transport.description: Invocation details: protocol, endpoint, and authentication. Required unless type is 'function'.

use_guidance.title: Use Guidance
use_guidance.description: Usage guidance for the model. Tells the model when to call and when to avoid this tool.

use_when.title: Use When
use_when.description: Conditions under which the model should call this tool.

avoid_when.title: Avoid When
avoid_when.description: Conditions under which the model should not call this tool.

side_effects.title: Side Effects
side_effects.description: Description of external side effects this tool may cause. Used as a warning to the model.

error_codes.title: Error Codes
error_codes.description: Map of HTTP status codes (as string keys) to error handling guidance for the model.

meaning.title: Meaning
meaning.description: Human-readable explanation of what this status code means in the context of this tool.

agent_action.title: Agent Action
agent_action.description: Instruction for the model on what to do when it receives this status code.

documentation.title: Documentation
documentation.description: Compiled from the Markdown body of the .tool.md file. Sections are optional but validated when present.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.description: Compiled from the optional '# Purpose' section. Why this tool exists and what problem it solves.

side_effects.title: Side Effects
side_effects.description: Compiled from the optional '# Side effects' section. Mutations, external calls, or other observable effects the tool produces.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Compiled from the optional '# Notes' section. Miscellaneous guidance for authors and reviewers.

aml_id.title: AML ID
aml_id.description: Stable, immutable AML identifier. Lowercase kebab-case or snake_case. Must match ^[a-z0-9_-]{3,64}$.

json_schema_object.title: JSON Schema Object
json_schema_object.description: A valid AML JSON Schema subset (draft-07). $ref, $id, definitions, and recursive schemas are not supported.

cred_none.title: Credential — none
cred_none.description: No authentication. Only valid for internal services on a fully trusted network boundary.

cred_iam_role.title: Credential — iam-role
cred_iam_role.description: Cloud-platform identity. The runtime uses the execution environment's attached identity (AWS IAM Role, GCP Workload Identity, Azure Managed Identity). No credential is stored or provisioned.

cred_api_key.title: Credential — api-key
cred_api_key.description: Static API key sent in an HTTP header. Valid for HTTP transports only (rest-api, mcp). Requires source and header; header is required with no default to avoid silent misconfiguration.

header.title: Header
header.description: HTTP header name to send the key in (e.g. X-Api-Key, Authorization).

name.title: Name
name.description: Env var name. Required when source=env.

secret_id.title: Secret ID
secret_id.description: AWS Secrets Manager secret ID. Required when source=aws_secrets_manager.

key.title: Key
key.description: Key within the secret JSON object if the secret is a JSON map.

project.title: Project
project.description: GCP project ID. Required when source=gcp_secret_manager.

secret.title: Secret
secret.description: GCP secret name. Required when source=gcp_secret_manager.

vault_url.title: Vault URL
vault_url.description: Azure Key Vault URL. Required when source=azure_key_vault.

secret_name.title: Secret Name
secret_name.description: Azure Key Vault secret name. Required when source=azure_key_vault.

cred_bearer_token.title: Credential — bearer-token
cred_bearer_token.description: Bearer token sent in the Authorization: Bearer <token> header. Valid for HTTP transports only (rest-api, mcp). Requires source.

name.title: Name
name.description: Env var name. Required when source=env.

secret_id.title: Secret ID
secret_id.description: AWS Secrets Manager secret ID. Required when source=aws_secrets_manager.

key.title: Key
key.description: Key within the secret JSON object if the secret is a JSON map.

project.title: Project
project.description: GCP project ID. Required when source=gcp_secret_manager.

secret.title: Secret
secret.description: GCP secret name. Required when source=gcp_secret_manager.

vault_url.title: Vault URL
vault_url.description: Azure Key Vault URL. Required when source=azure_key_vault.

secret_name.title: Secret Name
secret_name.description: Azure Key Vault secret name. Required when source=azure_key_vault.

cred_oauth2.title: Credential — oauth2
cred_oauth2.description: OAuth 2.0 dynamic token via a token broker lambda on the same cloud platform. The AML runtime invokes the lambda via iam-role (no additional credential required) to obtain a fresh bearer token before each API or MCP call. The lambda owns all token lifecycle concerns: acquisition, caching, refresh, and user-delegated lookup. The runtime sends the returned access_token as Authorization: Bearer. This keeps all OAuth business logic outside AML.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Cloud provider hosting the token broker lambda. Must be the same provider as the AML runtime — invoked via iam-role with no extra credential.

function_id.title: Function ID
function_id.description: Provider-specific identifier of the token broker function. AWS: full ARN (arn:aws:lambda:…). GCP: resource name (projects/…/functions/…). Azure: resource path or function URL.

scopes.title: Scopes
scopes.description: OAuth 2.0 scopes to pass as context to the token broker lambda. Optional.

cred_service_account.title: Credential — service-account
cred_service_account.description: Explicit service identity credential stored in a secret backend and resolved at runtime. Valid for cloud transports (lambda, message-queue, database). The resolved secret must be a JSON object containing provider-specific or engine-specific connection parameters (see docs for connection objects by provider/engine). For source=env the variable value must be a stringified JSON object. Use the key field to read a sub-object within a larger secret. Contrast with iam-role: service-account means you own and store the credential; iam-role means the platform manages it.

name.title: Name
name.description: Env var name. Required when source=env. The variable value must be a stringified JSON object with provider-specific or engine-specific connection fields.

secret_id.title: Secret ID
secret_id.description: AWS Secrets Manager secret ID. Required when source=aws_secrets_manager.

key.title: Key
key.description: Key within the secret JSON object if the secret is a JSON map.

project.title: Project
project.description: GCP project ID. Required when source=gcp_secret_manager.

secret.title: Secret
secret.description: GCP secret name. Required when source=gcp_secret_manager.

vault_url.title: Vault URL
vault_url.description: Azure Key Vault URL. Required when source=azure_key_vault.

secret_name.title: Secret Name
secret_name.description: Azure Key Vault secret name. Required when source=azure_key_vault.

cred_iam_role_db.title: Credential — iam-role (database)
cred_iam_role_db.description: Cloud-platform identity for database transport. The runtime uses the execution environment's attached identity — no secret is stored. Connection parameters are specified directly in this object. Required fields depend on the engine: host+port+database+username for postgresql/mysql/mssql; cluster_arn+database for rds-data-api; project for bigquery.

host.title: Host
host.description: Database host. Required for postgresql, mysql, mssql.

port.title: Port
port.description: Database port. Required for postgresql, mysql, mssql.

database.title: Database
database.description: Database name. Required for postgresql, mysql, mssql, rds-data-api.

username.title: Username
username.description: Database user configured for IAM authentication. Required for postgresql, mysql, mssql with RDS IAM token auth.

region.title: Region
region.description: AWS region. Required for RDS IAM token generation (postgresql, mysql, mssql on RDS).

cluster_arn.title: Cluster ARN
cluster_arn.description: Aurora Serverless cluster ARN. Required for rds-data-api.

project.title: Project
project.description: GCP project ID. Required for bigquery and Cloud SQL.

dataset.title: Dataset
dataset.description: BigQuery dataset name. Optional for bigquery.

credentials_http.title: Credentials (HTTP transports)
credentials_http.description: Credential schemes for HTTP-based transports (rest-api, mcp): none, api-key, bearer-token, oauth2. Cloud auth (iam-role, service-account) does not apply to HTTP transports.

credentials_cloud.title: Credentials (cloud transports)
credentials_cloud.description: Credential schemes for cloud-native transports (lambda, message-queue): iam-role or service-account. HTTP-style auth does not apply to these transports.

credentials_database.title: Credentials (database transport)
credentials_database.description: Credential schemes for database transport: iam-role (connection parameters embedded in the credential) or service-account (all connection parameters in the resolved secret JSON).

transport_retry_policy.title: Transport Retry Policy
transport_retry_policy.description: Retry policy for failed transport calls.

max_attempts.title: Max Attempts
max_attempts.description: Maximum number of attempts including the initial call.

on_status.title: On Status
on_status.description: HTTP status codes that should trigger a retry (e.g., [429, 503]).

backoff_ms.title: Backoff Ms
backoff_ms.description: Initial backoff in milliseconds between retries (exponential).

transport_rest_api.title: Transport — rest-api
transport_rest_api.description: REST API transport. Invokes the tool via an HTTP/HTTPS endpoint. All credential schemes are supported.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: HTTP method and path in 'METHOD /path' format (e.g., 'POST /send').

retry_policy.title: Retry Policy
retry_policy.description: Retry policy for failed HTTP calls.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.description: Authentication for this endpoint. HTTP schemes only: none, api-key, bearer-token, oauth2.

transport_lambda.title: Transport — lambda
transport_lambda.description: Serverless cloud function transport (AWS Lambda, Azure Functions, GCP Cloud Functions, etc.). Cloud credential schemes only.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Cloud provider running the function. aws=AWS Lambda; gcp=GCP Cloud Functions; azure=Azure Functions.

function_id.title: Function ID
function_id.description: Provider-specific identifier of the function. AWS: full ARN (arn:aws:lambda:…). Azure: resource path or function URL. GCP: resource name (projects/…/functions/…).

payload_format.title: Payload Format
payload_format.description: Format of the payload sent to and received from the function.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.description: Authentication for the cloud function: iam-role or service-account.

transport_mcp.title: Transport — mcp
transport_mcp.description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) transport. Invokes the tool via an MCP server. All credential schemes are supported.

tool_name.title: Tool Name
tool_name.description: Name of the tool as registered on the MCP server.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.description: Authentication for the MCP server. HTTP schemes only: none, api-key, bearer-token, oauth2.

transport_message_queue.title: Transport — message-queue
transport_message_queue.description: Message queue transport. Sends the tool call as a message to an async queue. All credential schemes are supported.

queue_url.title: Queue URL
queue_url.description: URL or ARN of the queue to send messages to.

response_queue_url.title: Response Queue URL
response_queue_url.description: Optional queue URL to receive responses from (for request-reply patterns).

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.description: Authentication for the queue provider: iam-role or service-account.

transport_database.title: Transport — database
transport_database.description: Relational database transport. All connection parameters live in the credentials: for service-account, the resolved secret is a JSON object with all engine-specific connection fields; for iam-role, connection parameters are specified directly in the credential object.

engine.title: Engine
engine.description: Database engine. rds-data-api is the AWS RDS Data API (Aurora Serverless v2).

query_method.title: Query Method
query_method.description: parameterised-sql (recommended, safe) or orm. Never use string interpolation.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.description: iam-role (connection fields in credential object) or service-account (all fields in resolved secret JSON).
